description.html: This 60x35x40 cm glass terrarium with a volume of 84 liters comes with a handmade 3D background that gives the interior the look of a natural habitat. The polystyrene background is sculpted as rock, tree bark or cave relief, and every piece is unique because it is made by hand in our workshop.

The horizontal layout with 60 cm of length gives a floor area where a basking zone, a cool zone and a hiding area are easy to arrange. Reptile thermoregulation depends on being able to move between warm and cool zones inside the terrarium. Mesh ventilation openings provide the airflow animals need to stay healthy and prevent condensation.

If the standard dimensions don't suit you, we build custom terrariums. Choose the size, film pattern, background style and extras such as LED lighting or a thermostat. Contact us for a quote. We deliver across Serbia.
